mapper.select: select m.item_mdl_cd , m.item_mdl_nm from tb_demo_item_mdl_m m where m.use_yn = 'Y' order by m.item_mdl_nm
mapper.insert: insert into tb_demo_item_hst_h ( item_no , hst_seq , item_kd_cd ) select i.item_no , (select ifnull(max(h.hst_seq), 0) + 1 from tb_demo_item_hst_h h where h.item_no = i.item_no) , i.item_kd_cd from tb_demo_item_m i where i.item_no = #{itemNo}
